{{Quote|It'll be boiled mealgrain until ''[the nuna]'' start laying ''[eggs]'' again.|[[Corr Skirata]]|<ref name="ImpCom501st" />}}
'''Boiled mealgrain''' was a dish made by members of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture. Prepared by boiling [[Grain/Legends|mealgrain]] in [[Water/Legends|water]], the dish was often eaten for breakfast.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Mandalorians of [[Clan Skirata]] attempted to [[Farm/Legends|farm]] [[Nuna/Legends|nuna]] [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] for their own private [[Foodstuff/Legends|consumption]] at their [[Kyrimorut/Legends|home]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of those efforts, however, the nuna were unable to keep pace with the demands of such a large clan, forcing the Skiratas to turn to boiled mealgrain for their breakfast needs until the nuna were able to lay more eggs.<ref name="ImpCom501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Boiled mealgrain was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'', the fifth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' novel series]] written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]], published [[October 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="ImpCom501st" />
